short_bio: American technology reviewer behind the MKBHD YouTube channel.
biography:
Marques Brownlee grew up in New Jersey and began posting tech reviews on YouTube in 2008. He studied at Stevens Institute of Technology.

His channel, MKBHD, is known for polished reviews of smartphones and other consumer technology.

In August 2019 he began co-hosting the podcast Waveform: The MKBHD Podcast, which combines product reviews with interviews of people influential in the technology industry.
